RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel selecting a qualified candidate is not evidence of discrimination. For a leadership position like Head of Group, qualitative strengths—such as client relationships, commercial vision, leadership style, and interview performance—frequently outweigh total years of experience once technical qualifications are met with eight years and chartered status. 

Raising allegations of gender bias without concrete evidence carries severe reputational and career risks within the engineering industry and offers no legal traction. Delays in post-interview feedback are common due to busy schedules. Instead, send a professional, polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interview performance, framing your inquiry strictly around personal growth rather than the panel's composition or the successful candidate's credentials.
